sanskrit: kanyā vār avāyatī somam api srutāvidat | astam bharanty abravīd indrāya sunavai tvā śakrāya sunavai tvā ||
english: A maiden, going to fetch water, found soma by a flowing stream; bearing it home she said: 'I will press thee for Indra, I will press thee for Śakra.'

sanskrit: asau ya eṣi vīrako gṛhaṁ-gṛhaṁ vicākaśad | imaṁ jambhasutam piba dhānāvantaṁ karambhiṇam apūpavantam ukthinam ||
english: O thou hero who goest shining from house to house — drink this soma pressed between the teeth, mingled with parched grain, mixed with gruel and sweet cakes, accompanied by lauds.

sanskrit: ā cana tvā cikitsāmo 'dhi cana tvā nemasi | śanair iva śanakair ivendrāyendo pari srava ||
english: We do not tend thee out of regard, we do not pour thee away out of neglect; gently, ever so gently, O drop, flow round for Indra.

sanskrit: kuvic chakat kuvit karat kuvinn no vasyasas karat | kuvit patidviṣo yatīr indreṇa saṁgamāmahai ||
english: Will he be able? Will he accomplish it? Will he bring us into greater prosperity? Will women who hate their husbands meet together with Indra?

sanskrit: imāni trīṇi viṣṭapā tānīndra vi rohaya | śiras tatasyo rvarāṁm ād idam ma upodare ||
english: These three flat surfaces — make them grow, O Indra: the head of that bald man, the field yonder, and this my belly.

sanskrit: asau ca yā na urvarād imāṁ tanvaṁ mama | atho tatasya yac chiraḥ sarvā tā romaśā kṛdhi ||
english: Both that field of ours, and this body of mine — and the head of that bald man — make all of them hairy.

sanskrit: khe rathasya khe 'nasaḥ khe yugasya śatakrato | apālām indra triṣ pūtvy akṛṇoḥ sūryatvacam ||
english: In the nave of the chariot, in the nave of the cart, in the nave of the yoke, O Śatakratu — Indra, thou didst purify Apālā thrice, making her skin radiant as the sun.

sanskrit: pāntam ā vo andhasa indram abhi pra gāyata | viśvāsāhaṁ śatakratum maṁhiṣṭhaṁ carṣaṇīnām ||
english: Sing forth to Indra, the guardian of your soma-draught, the all-conquering, the Śatakratu, the most bounteous among men.

sanskrit: puruhūtam puruṣṭutaṁ gāthānyaṁ sanaśrutam | indra iti bravītana ||
english: Him who is called by many, praised by many, celebrated in songs, ever-famed — call him 'Indra'!

sanskrit: indra in no mahānāṁ dātā vājānāṁ nṛtuḥ | mahāṁ abhijñv ā yamat ||
english: Indra indeed is the giver of great prizes and of vigour to us; the mighty one stoops down to his knee.

sanskrit: apād u śipry andhasaḥ sudakṣasya proṣiṇaḥ | indor indro yavāśiraḥ ||
english: With his beautiful jaw Indra has fully drunk from the inebriating soma-juice of Indu, of great power, of abounding stimulation — the soma mixed with barley.

sanskrit: tam v abhi prārcatendraṁ somasya pītaye | tad id dhy asya vardhanam ||
english: Sing forth to that Indra for the drinking of soma; this indeed is his increase.

sanskrit: asya pītvā madānāṁ devo devasyaujasā | viśvābhi bhuvanā bhuvat ||
english: Having drunk of his exhilarating draughts, a god through the power of the god, he becomes lord over all the worlds.

sanskrit: tyam u vaḥ satrāsāhaṁ viśvāsu gīrṣv āyatam | ā cyāvayasy ūtaye ||
english: Him, the all-conquering one, whom you set in motion in all your songs — invite thou him to come hither for our aid.

sanskrit: yudhmaṁ santam anarvāṇaṁ somapām anapacyutam | naram avāryakratum ||
english: The warrior ever unconquered, the soma-drinker never falling away, the man whose will none can check.

sanskrit: śikṣā ṇa indra rāya ā puru vidvāṁ ṛcīṣama | avā naḥ pārye dhane ||
english: Grant us wealth, O Indra, thou who art very wise; O sage, help us at the decisive contest.

sanskrit: ataś cid indra ṇa upā yāhi śatavājayā | iṣā sahasravājayā ||
english: Come hither to us even from afar, O Indra, with a hundred prizes, with nourishment winning a thousand prizes.

sanskrit: ayāma dhīvato dhiyo 'rvadbhiḥ śakra godare | jayema pṛtsu vajrivaḥ ||
english: Let us pursue the thoughts of the devout with our swift steeds, O Śakra, winner of kine; may we conquer in battles, O wielder of the bolt.

sanskrit: vayam u tvā śatakrato gāvo na yavaseṣv ā | uktheṣu raṇayāmasi ||
english: We, O Śatakratu, rejoice in thee with our lauds as cows in pastures.

sanskrit: viśvā hi martyatvanānukāmā śatakrato | aganma vajrinn āśasaḥ ||
english: For all that belongs to mortality is desirous of following, O Śatakratu; we have come to thee, O wielder of the bolt, with our hopes.

sanskrit: tve su putra śavasovṛtran kāmakātayaḥ | na tvām indrāti ricyate ||
english: In thee, O son of strength, are concentrated the desires of those who slay Vṛtra; none surpasses thee, O Indra.

sanskrit: sa no vṛṣan saniṣṭhayā saṁ ghorayā dravitnvā | dhiyāviḍḍhi puraṁdhyā ||
english: Do thou, O bull, assist us with thy most excellent, most terrible, most swift bounty; fill us with understanding and with abundance.

sanskrit: yas te nūnaṁ śatakratav indra dyumnitamo madaḥ | tena nūnam made madeḥ ||
english: That rapture of thine which is now most glorious, O Indra, O Śatakratu — in that exhilaration be thou now exhilarated.

sanskrit: yas te citraśravastamo ya indra vṛtrahantamaḥ | ya ojodātamo madaḥ ||
english: That rapture of thine which is most wonderfully famous, O Indra, which is most mighty for the slaying of Vṛtra, which is the greatest giver of vigour.

sanskrit: vidmā hi yas te adrivas tvādattaḥ satya somapāḥ | viśvāsu dasma kṛṣṭiṣu ||
english: We know indeed that rapture of thine, O lord of the stone-bolt, given by thee thyself, O true soma-drinker, among all peoples, O wondrous one.

sanskrit: indrāya madvane sutam pari ṣṭobhantu no giraḥ | arkam arcantu kāravaḥ ||
english: Let our praises surround the soma pressed for Indra's exhilaration; let the singers intone their hymn.

sanskrit: yasmin viśvā adhi śriyo raṇanti sapta saṁsadaḥ | indraṁ sute havāmahe ||
english: In whom all glories resound, the seven assemblies — we invoke Indra at the soma-pressing.

sanskrit: trikadrukeṣu cetanaṁ devāso yajñam atnata | tam id vardhantu no giraḥ ||
english: The gods stretched forth the conscious sacrifice at the three soma-bowls; let our praises magnify that.

sanskrit: ā tvā viśantv indavaḥ samudram iva sindhavaḥ | na tvām indrāti ricyate ||
english: Let the soma-drops flow into thee as rivers into the ocean; none surpasses thee, O Indra.

sanskrit: vivyaktha mahinā vṛṣan bhakṣaṁ somasya jāgṛve | ya indra jaṭhareṣu te ||
english: Thou hast spread wide with thy greatness, O bull, the drinking of soma for the wakeful — that which is in thy belly, O Indra.

sanskrit: araṁ ta indra kukṣaye somo bhavatu vṛtrahan | araṁ dhāmabhya indavaḥ ||
english: Let the soma be ready for thy belly, O Indra the Vṛtra-slayer; let the soma-drops be ready for thy seats.

sanskrit: aram aśvāya gāyati śrutakakṣo araṁ gave | aram indrasya dhāmne ||
english: The far-famed singer sings readiness for the horse, readiness for the cow, readiness for Indra's dwelling.

sanskrit: araṁ hi ṣma suteṣu naḥ someṣv indra bhūṣasi | araṁ te śakra dāvane ||
english: For thou art ever ready to grace our pressed somas, O Indra; thou art ready, O Śakra, for giving.

sanskrit: parākāttāc cid adrivas tvāṁ nakṣanta no giraḥ | araṁ gamāma te vayam ||
english: Even from afar may our praises reach thee, O lord of the stone-bolt; may we come to meet thee.

sanskrit: evā hy asi vīrayur evā śūra uta sthiraḥ | evā te rādhyam manaḥ ||
english: For thus thou art heroic, thus, O hero, thou art also firm; thus is thy mind apt for liberality.

sanskrit: evā rātis tuvīmagha viśvebhir dhāyi dhātṛbhiḥ | adhā cid indra me sacā ||
english: Thus was thy gift established, O thou of great wealth, by all the ordaining powers; be thou still with me, O Indra.

sanskrit: mo ṣu brahmeva tandrayur bhuvo vājānām pate | matsvā sutasya gomataḥ ||
english: Do not become sluggish like a brahmin, O lord of prizes; be exhilarated with the pressed soma mixed with milk.

sanskrit: mā na indrābhy ādiśaḥ sūro aktuṣv ā yaman | tvā yujā vanema tat ||
english: Let not the sun outshine us, O Indra, as he traverses the rays of light; with thee as ally may we win that prize.

sanskrit: tvayed indra yujā vayam prati bruvīmahi spṛdhaḥ | tvam asmākaṁ tava smasi ||
english: With thee, O Indra, as our ally, may we respond to our rivals; thou art ours and we are thine.

sanskrit: tvām id dhi tvāyavo anunuvutaś carān | sakhāya indra kāravaḥ ||
english: Thee indeed thy devotees follow as they roam, praising thee ever; thy friends the singers, O Indra.

sanskrit: ud ghed abhi śrutāmaghaṁ vṛṣabhaṁ naryāpasam | astāram eṣi sūrya ||
english: Thou risest up indeed toward the far-famed, wealth-bestowing bull whose works are manly — thou goest to the shooter, O Sun.

sanskrit: nava yo navatiṁ puro bibheda bāhvojasā | ahiṁ ca vṛtrahāvadhīt ||
english: He who broke ninety-nine fortresses with the strength of his arms, and with the power of the Vṛtra-slayer slew the serpent.

sanskrit: sa na indraḥ śivaḥ sakhā aśvāvad gomad yavamat | urudhāreva dohate ||
english: May that Indra be our auspicious friend, who milks for us abundance of horses, kine, and barley — like a cow with flowing streams.

sanskrit: yad adya kac ca vṛtrahann udagā abhi sūrya | sarvaṁ tad indra te vaśe ||
english: Whatever exists today, O Vṛtra-slayer, since the sun rose over all — all that, O Indra, is in thy power.

sanskrit: yad vā pravṛddha satpate na marā iti manyase | uto tat satyam it tava ||
english: Or if thou, O full-grown lord of the righteous, dost think 'I shall not die' — that too is truly thine.

sanskrit: ye somāsaḥ parāvati ye arvāvati sunvire | sarvāṁs tāṁ indra gacchasi ||
english: The soma pressings that are done in the distant region, the soma pressings done in the near region — to all of them, O Indra, thou goest.

sanskrit: tam indraṁ vājayāmasi mahe vṛtrāya hantave | sa vṛṣā vṛṣabho bhuvat ||
english: We stimulate that Indra to slay the mighty Vṛtra; may he be the bull among bulls.

sanskrit: indraḥ sa dāmane kṛta ojiṣṭhaḥ sa made hitaḥ | dyumnī ślokī sa somyaḥ ||
english: That Indra is fashioned for giving, he is the mightiest; he is devoted to exhilaration, glorious, renowned, devoted to soma.

sanskrit: girā vajro na sambhṛtaḥ sabalo anapacyutaḥ | vavakṣa ṛṣvo astṛtaḥ ||
english: Like a thunderbolt assembled by a hymn, together with his power, never giving way — the vigorous, unconquered one has grown strong.

sanskrit: durge cin naḥ sugaṁ kṛdhi gṛṇāna indra girvaṇaḥ | tvaṁ ca maghavan vaśaḥ ||
english: Make for us easy passage even through difficulty, as thou art praised, O Indra, lover of hymns; thou art our desire, O Maghavan.

sanskrit: yasya te nū cid ādiśaṁ na minanti svarājyam | na devo nādhrigur janaḥ ||
english: Thy self-rule, even the slightest command of which no god, no wretched man diminishes.

sanskrit: adhā te apratiṣkutaṁ devī śuṣmaṁ saparyataḥ | ubhe suśipra rodasī ||
english: Then the two divine worlds, heaven and earth with beautiful jaws, serve thy irresistible might.

sanskrit: tvam etad adhārayaḥ kṛṣṇāsu rohiṇīṣu ca | paruṣṇīṣu ruśat payaḥ ||
english: Thou hast sustained the bright milk in the dark cows and in the tawny ones, and in those of the Paruṣṇī river.

sanskrit: vi yad aher adha tviṣo viśve devāso akramuḥ | vidan mṛgasya tām̐ amaḥ ||
english: When all the gods stepped away from the serpent's flash of brilliance, they found the disease of the wild beast.

sanskrit: ād u me nivaro bhuvad vṛtrahādiṣṭa pauṁsyam | ajātaśatrur astṛtaḥ ||
english: Then may there be protection for me; the Vṛtra-slayer has commanded manly valour; he who has no born enemy is unconquered.

sanskrit: śrutaṁ vo vṛtrahantamam pra śardhaṁ carṣaṇīnām | ā śuṣe rādhase mahe ||
english: I proclaim for you the most famous Vṛtra-slayer, the champion of men, for the attainment of great riches.

sanskrit: ayā dhiyā ca gavyayā puruṇāman puruṣṭuta | yat some-soma ābhavaḥ ||
english: With this thought that seeks kine, O thou of many names, praised by many — by whatever soma thou hast appeared at each soma-feast.

sanskrit: bodhinmanā id astu no vṛtrahā bhūryāsutiḥ | śṛṇotu śakra āśiṣam ||
english: May he be attentive to us — the Vṛtra-slayer, the lavish with libations; may Śakra hear our prayer.

sanskrit: kayā tvaṁ na ūtyābhi pra mandase vṛṣan | kayā stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
english: With what aid dost thou exhilarate thyself toward us, O bull? With what dost thou bring abundance to the singers?

sanskrit: kasya vṛṣā sute sacā niyutvān vṛṣabho raṇat | vṛtrahā somapītaye ||
english: For whom does the bull, the Vṛtra-slayer, together with his team, rejoice at the pressing, the bull for the drinking of soma?

sanskrit: abhī ṣu ṇas tvaṁ rayim mandasānaḥ sahasriṇam | prayantā bodhi dāśuṣe ||
english: Come to us and, exhilarating thyself, be the bringer of thousandfold riches to the worshipper.

sanskrit: patnīvantaḥ sutā ima uśanto yanti vītaye | apāṁ jagmir nicumpuṇaḥ ||
english: These somas pressed with their consorts go eagerly to the enjoyment; the drinker of waters, Indra, comes to the purified drops.

sanskrit: iṣṭā hotrā asṛkṣatendraṁ vṛdhāso adhvare | acchāvabhṛtham ojasā ||
english: The desired invocations, the augmenting ones, have been let loose toward Indra at the sacrifice; toward the final bath with vigour.

sanskrit: iha tyā sadhamādyā harī hiraṇyakeśyā | voḻhām abhi prayo hitam ||
english: Here let those two revelling bay steeds with golden manes draw toward the oblation prepared for them.

sanskrit: tubhyaṁ somāḥ sutā ime stīrṇam barhir vibhāvaso | stotṛbhya indram ā vaha ||
english: For thee are these soma-drops pressed, the sacred grass is strewn, O all-illumining; bring Indra to the singers.

sanskrit: ā te dakṣaṁ vi rocanā dadhad ratnā vi dāśuṣe | stotṛbhya indram arcata ||
english: As he places in thee luminous power and distributes treasure to the worshipper — sing to Indra for the singers.

sanskrit: ā te dadhāmīndriyam ukthā viśvā śatakrato | stotṛbhya indra mṛḻaya ||
english: I place all the lauds in thy heroic power, O Śatakratu; be gracious to the singers, O Indra.

sanskrit: bhadram-bhadraṁ na ā bhareṣam ūrjaṁ śatakrato | yad indra mṛḻayāsi naḥ ||
english: Bring us blessing after blessing, bring vigour, O Śatakratu — whensoever thou art gracious to us, O Indra.

sanskrit: sa no viśvāny ā bhara suvitāni śatakrato | yad indra mṛḻayāsi naḥ ||
english: Bring us all good things, O Śatakratu — whensoever thou art gracious to us, O Indra.

sanskrit: tvām id vṛtrahantama sutāvanto havāmahe | yad indra mṛḻayāsi naḥ ||
english: Thee only, O mightiest Vṛtra-slayer, do we who press the soma invoke — whensoever thou art gracious to us, O Indra.

sanskrit: upa no haribhiḥ sutaṁ yāhi madānām pate | upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||
english: Come to our pressed soma with thy bay steeds, O lord of exhilarations; come to our pressed soma with thy bay steeds.

sanskrit: dvitā yo vṛtrahantamo vida indraḥ śatakratuḥ | upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||
english: He who is doubly the mightiest Vṛtra-slayer, Indra, the Śatakratu — come to our pressed soma with thy bay steeds.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hi vṛtrahann eṣām pātā somānām asi | upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||
english: For thou, O Vṛtra-slayer, art the guardian of these somas — come to our pressed soma with thy bay steeds.

sanskrit: indra iṣe dadātu na ṛbhukṣaṇam ṛbhuṁ rayim | vājī dadātu vājinam ||
english: May Indra give us food, the ample, Ṛbhu-like wealth; may the prize-winner give us the prize.

sanskrit: gaur dhayati marutāṁ śravasyur mātā maghonām | yuktā vahnī rathānām ||
english: The cow suckles the Maruts' fame-seeking mother of the wealthy; yoked are the two draught-horses of the chariots.

sanskrit: yasyā devā upasthe vratā viśve dhārayante | sūryāmāsā dṛśe kam ||
english: In whose lap all the gods sustain all their ordinances, the sun and moon for the beautiful sight.

sanskrit: tat su no viśve arya ā sadā gṛṇanti kāravaḥ | marutaḥ somapītaye ||
english: That do all the noble ones ever call for us, the singers — O Maruts, for the drinking of soma.

sanskrit: asti somo ayaṁ sutaḥ pibanty asya marutaḥ | uta svarājo aśvinā ||
english: This soma is pressed; the Maruts drink of it, and the self-ruling Aśvins also.

sanskrit: pibanti mitro aryamā tanā pūtasya varuṇaḥ | triṣadsthasya jāvataḥ ||
english: Mitra and Aryaman and Varuṇa drink of the purified, swift soma that has three seats.

sanskrit: uto nv asya joṣam āṁ indraḥ sutasya gomataḥ | prātar hoteva matsati ||
english: And now Indra too takes pleasure in this pressed soma mixed with milk, exhilarated like a morning hotar-priest.

sanskrit: kad atviṣanta sūrayas tira āpa iva sridhaḥ | arṣanti pūtadakṣasaḥ ||
english: How do the luminaries shine, like waters across the currents? They flow, those of purified power.

sanskrit: kad vo adya mahānāṁ devānām avo vṛṇe | tmanā ca dasmavarcasām ||
english: Which of the great gods' aids shall I choose today, and of the wondrous-radiant ones by their own power?

sanskrit: ā ye viśvā pārthivāni paprathan rocanā divaḥ | marutaḥ somapītaye ||
english: They who have spread out all earthly things and the luminous regions of the sky — O Maruts, for the drinking of soma.

sanskrit: tyān nu pūtadakṣaso divo vo maruto huve | asya somasya pītaye ||
english: Those pure-powered ones of heaven, O Maruts, I now invoke you — for the drinking of this soma.

sanskrit: tyān nu ye vi rodasī tastabhur maruto huve | asya somasya pītaye ||
english: Those who have propped apart the two worlds, the Maruts, I now invoke — for the drinking of this soma.

sanskrit: tyaṁ nu mārutaṁ gaṇaṁ giriṣṭhāṁ vṛṣaṇaṁ huve | asya somasya pītaye ||
english: That troop of Maruts dwelling on the mountains, the bulls — I now invoke them for the drinking of this soma.

sanskrit: ā tvā giro rathīr ivāsthuḥ suteṣu girvaṇaḥ | abhi tvā sam anūṣatendra vatsaṁ na mātaraḥ ||
english: The hymns have come to thee like chariot-warriors at the soma-pressings, O lover of praises; they have lowed toward thee together, O Indra, as mothers toward a calf.

sanskrit: ā tvā śukrā acucyavuḥ sutāsa indra girvaṇaḥ | pibā tv asyāndhasa indra viśvāsu te hitam ||
english: The bright pressed soma-drops have stirred thee, O Indra, lover of praises; drink now of this soma-juice, O Indra — it is established for thee in all things.

sanskrit: pibā somam madāya kam indra śyenābhṛtaṁ sutam | tvaṁ hi śaśvatīnāṁ patī rājā viśām asi ||
english: Drink the soma pressed for exhilaration, O Indra, brought by the eagle — for thou art the lord and king of all eternal peoples.

sanskrit: śrudhī havaṁ tirascyā indra yas tvā saparyati | suvīryasya gomato rāyas pūrdhi mahāṁ asi ||
english: Hear the call of Tirascī, O Indra, who worships thee; fill him with wealth in heroes and kine — thou art great.

sanskrit: indra yas te navīyasīṁ giram mandrām ajījanat | cikitvinnmanasaṁ dhiyam pratnām ṛtasya pipyuṣīm ||
english: O Indra, he who has brought forth for thee the newest, most pleasing hymn — the thought full of understanding, the ancient one swelling with Order.

sanskrit: tam u ṣṭavāma yaṁ gira indram ukthāni vāvṛduḥ | purūṇy asya pauṁsyā siṣāsanto vanāmahe ||
english: Let us now praise that Indra whom hymns and lauds have magnified; eager to win his many manly deeds, we celebrate him.

sanskrit: eto nv indraṁ stavāma śuddhaṁ śuddhena sāmnā | śuddhair ukthair vāvṛdhvāṁsaṁ śuddha āśīrvān mamattu ||
english: Come now, let us praise Indra the pure with a pure sāman-chant; let him who is magnified by pure lauds, the pure one, be gladdened by a pure invocation.

sanskrit: indra śuddho na ā gahi śuddhaḥ śuddhābhir ūtibhiḥ | śuddho rayiṁ ni dhāraya śuddho mamaddhi somyaḥ ||
english: Come to us as the pure Indra, O pure one, with pure aids; as the pure one establish wealth for us; as the pure, soma-loving one, be exhilarated.

sanskrit: indra śuddho hi no rayiṁ śuddho ratnāni dāśuṣe | śuddho vṛtrāṇi jighnase śuddho vājaṁ siṣāsasi ||
english: Indra, pure, thou givest us wealth; pure, thou bestowest treasures on the worshipper; pure, thou smitest Vṛtras; pure, thou seekest to win the prize.

sanskrit: asmā uṣāsa ātiranta yāmam indrāya naktam ūrmyāḥ suvācaḥ | asmā āpo mātaraḥ sapta tasthu nṛbhyas tarāya sindhavaḥ supārāḥ ||
english: The sweet-sounding dawns of night stretched out their path for Indra; for him the seven mother-waters stood as rivers easy to ford, for men to cross over.

sanskrit: atividdhā vithureṇā cid astrā triḥ sapta sānu saṁhitā girīṇām | na tad devo na martyas tuturyād yāni pravṛddho vṛṣabhaś cakāra ||
english: Though pierced through, the weapon of even a tottering one — thrice seven ridges of the mountains joined together — no god nor mortal could pass what the mighty bull accomplished.

sanskrit: indrasya vajra āyaso nimiśla indrasya bāhvor bhūyiṣṭham ojaḥ | śīrṣann indrasya kratavo nireka āsann eṣanta śrutyā upāke ||
english: Indra's bolt is of iron, plunging deep; in Indra's two arms is the greatest vigour; Indra's thoughts poured out from his head, they streamed forth, heard nearby.

sanskrit: manye tvā yajñiyaṁ yajñiyānāṁ manye tvā cyavanam acyutānām | manye tvā satvanām indra ketum manye tvā vṛṣabhaṁ carṣaṇīnām ||
english: I deem thee the most adorable of those who deserve worship; I deem thee the shaker of the unshakeable; I deem thee, O Indra, the banner of warriors; I deem thee the bull of mankind.

sanskrit: ā yad vajram bāhvor indra dhatse madacyutam ahaye hantavā u | pra parvatā anavanta pra gāvaḥ pra brahmāṇo abhinakṣanta indram ||
english: When thou dost take up in thy arms the bolt, the exhilaration-shedder, to slay the serpent — forth cried the mountains, forth the cows; the priests drew near to Indra.

sanskrit: tam u ṣṭavāma ya imā jajāna viśvā jātāny avarāṇy asmāt | indreṇa mitraṁ didhiṣema gīrbhir upo namobhir vṛṣabhaṁ viśema ||
english: Let us praise him who has produced all these beings inferior to himself; may we secure friendship with Indra through our songs; may we approach the bull with reverences.

sanskrit: vṛtrasya tvā śvasathād īṣamāṇā viśve devā ajahur ye sakhāyaḥ | marudbhir indra sakhyaṁ te astv athemā viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayāsi ||
english: All the gods who were thy friends abandoned thee as thou wert striving, driven by Vṛtra's roar; may thy friendship with the Maruts be established, O Indra, and then conquer all these hosts.

sanskrit: triḥ ṣaṣṭis tvā maruto vāvṛdhānā usrā iva rāśayo yajñiyāsaḥ | upa tvemaḥ kṛdhi no bhāgadheya śuṣmaṁ ta enā haviṣā vidhema ||
english: The thrice-sixty Maruts, grown mighty like heaps of dawn-cattle, adorable — we come to thee; make us partakers of thy share; with this oblation may we worship thy vigour.

sanskrit: tigmam āyudham marutām anīkaṁ kas ta indra prati vajraṁ dadharṣa | anāyudhāso asurā adevāś cakreṇa tāṁ apa vapa ṛjīṣin ||
english: Sharp is the Maruts' weapon, their army — who has dared to oppose thy thunderbolt, O Indra? The Asuras without weapons, the godless — with thy discus, shear them away, O Ṛjīṣin.

sanskrit: maha ugrāya tavase suvṛktim preraya śivatamāya paśvaḥ | girvāhase gira indrāya pūrvīr dhehi tanve kuvid aṅga vedat ||
english: Send forth a well-formed hymn to the great, mighty, most auspicious one, the possessor of cattle; direct many praises to Indra, the hymn-borne; may he perchance find something for his own being.

sanskrit: ukthavāhase vibhve manīṣāṁ druṇā na pāram īrayā nadīnām | ni spṛśa dhiyā tanvi śrutasya juṣṭatarasya kuvid aṅga vedat ||
english: For the far-spreading laud-bearer, direct thy thought as one directs a raft to the far bank of rivers; touch with thy thought that being of the renowned and ever more beloved — may he perchance find it.

sanskrit: tad viviḍḍhi yat ta indro jujoṣat stuhi suṣṭutiṁ namasā vivāsa | upa bhūṣa jaritar mā ruvaṇyaḥ śrāvayā vācaṁ kuvid aṅga vedat ||
english: Discover what Indra has enjoyed; praise with a fine hymn, seek to win by reverence; approach with care, O singer — do not cry aloud; let thy voice be heard — may he perchance find it.

sanskrit: ava drapso aṁśumatīm atiṣṭhad iyānaḥ kṛṣṇo daśabhiḥ sahasraiḥ | āvat tam indraḥ śacyā dhamantam apa snehitīr nṛmaṇā adhatta ||
english: The dark drop descended and stood on the Aṁśumatī river, moving with ten thousands; Indra, the man-minded one, aided him who was blowing, and took away from him his slippery ones.

sanskrit: drapsam apaśyaṁ viṣuṇe carantam upahvare nadyo aṁśumatyāḥ | nabho na kṛṣṇam avatasthi āṁsa iṣyāmi vo vṛṣaṇo yudhyatājau ||
english: I saw the drop wandering at the meeting-point, in the bend of the Aṁśumatī river, standing like a dark cloud come down — I urge you on, O bulls, fighting in battle.

sanskrit: adha drapso aṁśumatyā upasthe adhārayat tanvaṁ titviṣāṇaḥ | viśo adevīr abhy ācarantīr bṛhaspatinā yujendraḥ sasāhe ||
english: Then the drop, shining brightly, held its form in the lap of the Aṁśumatī; Indra allied with Bṛhaspati overcame the ungodly tribes that came against him.

sanskrit: tvaṁ ha tyat saptabhyo jāyamāno aśatrubhyo abhavaḥ śatrur indra | gūḍhe dyāvāpṛthivī anv avindo vibhumadbhyo bhuvanebhyo raṇaṁ dhāḥ ||
english: Being born from the seven, thou becamest an enemy to those who had no enemy, O Indra; thou foundest heaven and earth that were hidden; thou didst establish battle for the worlds of the far-extending.

sanskrit: tvaṁ ha tyad apratimānam ojo vajreṇa vajrin dhṛṣito jaghantha | tvaṁ śuṣṇasyāvātiro vadhatrais tvaṁ gā indra śacyed avindaḥ ||
english: Thou boldly didst strike that unequalled strength with thy bolt, O wielder of the bolt; with thy weapons thou didst descend against Śuṣṇa; thou didst find the cows, O Indra, by thy power.

sanskrit: tvaṁ ha tyad vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnāṁ ghano vṛtrāṇāṁ taviṣo babhūtha | tvaṁ sindhūṁr asṛjas tastabhānān tvam apo ajayo dāsapatnīḥ ||
english: Thou, O bull of mankind, didst become the mighty smiter of Vṛtras; thou didst release the rivers that were dammed up; thou didst conquer the waters that had Dāsa lords.

sanskrit: sa sukratū raṇitā yaḥ suteṣv anuttamanyu yo aheva revān | ya eka in nary apāṁsi kartā sa vṛtrahā pratīd anyam āhuḥ ||
english: He of good counsel who rejoices at the soma-pressings, whose anger is unbeaten, who is rich as a serpent — he alone, the manly doer of deeds, is the Vṛtra-slayer; otherwise they call him another.

sanskrit: sa vṛtrahendraś carṣaṇīdhṛt taṁ suṣṭutyā havyaṁ huvema | sa prāvitā maghavā no adhivaktā sa vājasya śravasyasya dātā ||
english: He is the Vṛtra-slaying Indra, the sustainer of men; him let us invoke as the worthy one with praise; he will be our protector, our Maghavan, our patron; he is the giver of vigour and fame.

sanskrit: sa vṛtrahendra ṛbhukṣāḥ sadyo jajñāno havyo babhūva | kṛṇvann apāṁsi naryā purūṇi somo na pīto havyaḥ sakhibhyaḥ ||
english: That Vṛtra-slaying Indra, the Ṛbhukṣan, born at once, became the worthy one to be invoked; performing many manly deeds, like soma when drunk, worthy of invocation for friends.

sanskrit: yā indra bhuja ābharaḥ svarvāṁ asurebhyaḥ | stotāram in maghavann asya vardhaya ye ca tve vṛktabarhiṣaḥ ||
english: The riches, the sun-wealth that thou didst bring away from the Asuras, O Indra — increase, O Maghavan, the wealth of this singer, and of those who have trimmed the sacred grass for thee.

sanskrit: yam indra dadhiṣe tvam aśvaṁ gām bhāgam avyayam | yajamāne sunvati dakṣiṇāvati tasmin taṁ dhehi mā paṇau ||
english: The horse, the cow, the unfailing share that thou, O Indra, dost apportion — place it in the sacrificer who presses soma and gives the sacrificial fee; not in the miser.

sanskrit: ya indra sasty avrato anuṣvāpam adevayuḥ | svaiḥ ṣa evair mumurat poṣyaṁ rayiṁ sanutar dhehi taṁ tataḥ ||
english: He who, O Indra, sleeps out of season, the ungodly, the slumberer — let him perish by his own means; place his nourishing riches far away from there.

sanskrit: yac chakrāsi parāvati yad arvāvati vṛtrahan | atas tvā gīrbhir dyugad indra keśibhiḥ sutāvāṁ ā vivāsati ||
english: Whether thou, O Śakra, art in the distant region or in the near region, O Vṛtra-slayer — the soma-presser seeks thee hither from that distance with shining songs, O Indra, with hymns that reach the sky.

sanskrit: yad vāsi rocane divaḥ samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi | yat pārthive sadane vṛtrahantama yad antarikṣa ā gahi ||
english: Whether thou art in the luminous realm of heaven, above the layer of the ocean, or in an earthly dwelling, O mightiest Vṛtra-slayer, or in the atmosphere — come hither.

sanskrit: sa naḥ someṣu somapāḥ suteṣu śavasas pate | mādayasva rādhasā sūnṛtāvatendra rāyā parīṇasā ||
english: Be thou exhilarated, O soma-drinker, at our soma-feasts, at our pressings, O lord of might; with thy bountiful gift, O truth-possessing Indra, with thy wealth abounding on all sides.

sanskrit: mā na indra parā vṛṇag bhavā naḥ sadhamādyaḥ | tvaṁ na ūtī tvam in na āpyam mā na indra parā vṛṇak ||
english: Turn not away from us, O Indra; be our companion in revelry; thou art our ally, thou art our kinsman — turn not away from us, O Indra.

sanskrit: asme indra sacā sute ni ṣadā pītaye madhu | kṛdhī jaritre maghavann avo mahad asme indra sacā sute ||
english: Sit down here with us, O Indra, at the pressed soma to drink the sweetness; grant great aid to the singer, O Maghavan — with us, O Indra, at the pressed soma.

sanskrit: na tvā devāsa āśata na martyāso adrivaḥ | viśvā jātāni śavasābhibhūr asi na tvā devāsa āśata ||
english: Neither the gods nor mortal men have ever equalled thee, O lord of the bolt; thou art the overpowerer of all creatures by thy might — neither the gods have equalled thee.

sanskrit: viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaraṁ naraṁ sajūs tatakṣur indraṁ jajanś ca rājase | kratvā variṣṭhaṁ vara āmurim utogram ojiṣṭhaṁ tavasaṁ tarasvinam ||
english: Together they fashioned and begat Indra, the man most overpowering of all hosts, to be king — him most excellent in will, the bounteous, undying one, utterly fierce, most vigorous, mighty, and swift.

sanskrit: sam īṁ rebhāso asvarann indraṁ somasya pītaye | svarpatiṁ yad īṁ vṛdhe dhṛtavrato hy ojasā sam ūtibhiḥ ||
english: Together the singers chanted to Indra for the drinking of soma — the lord of the sun, who is established for his growth, firm in his vows, by his power and his aids.

sanskrit: nemiṁ namanti cakṣasā meṣaṁ viprā abhisvarā | sudītayo vo adruho api karṇe tarasvinaḥ sam ṛkvabhiḥ ||
english: The inspired singers, calling aloud, bow down with their gaze to the rim of the wheel and to the ram; your bright ones, free from enmity, swift in the ear — they come together with hymns.

sanskrit: tam indraṁ johavīmi maghavānam ugraṁ satrā dadhānam apratiṣkutaṁ śavāṁsi | maṁhiṣṭho gīrbhir ā ca yajñiyo vavartad rāye no viśvā supathā kṛṇotu vajrī ||
english: I invoke again and again that Indra, the bounteous, the mighty, who holds irresistible strengths; most generous with hymns, may he, the adorable, turn back, and may the wielder of the bolt make for us all good paths to wealth.

sanskrit: tvam pura indra cikid enā vy ojasā śaviṣṭha śakra nāśayadhyai | tvad viśvāni bhuvanāni vajrin dyāvā rejete pṛthivī ca bhīṣā ||
english: Thou, O Indra, formerly didst know how to destroy these with thy might, O mightiest Śakra; from thee all the worlds tremble, O wielder of the bolt, and heaven and earth with fear.

sanskrit: tan ma ṛtam indra śūra citra pātv apo na vajrin duritāti parṣi bhūri | kadā na indra rāya ā daśasyer viśvapsnyasya spṛhayāyyasya rājan ||
english: May that Order, O heroic, wondrous Indra, protect me; like water, O wielder of the bolt, carry me over many difficulties; when wilt thou, O Indra, richly bestow on us the all-nourishing and desirable wealth, O king?

sanskrit: indrāya sāma gāyata viprāya bṛhate bṛhat | dharmakṛte vipaścite panasyave ||
english: Sing a great sāman to Indra, to the inspired, to the great; to him who establishes Order, the wise, the praiseworthy.

sanskrit: tvam indrābhibhūr asi tvaṁ sūryam arocayaḥ | viśvakarmā viśvadevo mahāṁ asi ||
english: Thou art the overpowerer, O Indra; thou didst make the sun to shine; thou art the all-maker, the all-deity, the great one.

sanskrit: vibhrājañ jyotiṣā svar agaccho rocanaṁ divaḥ | devās ta indra sakhyāya yemire ||
english: Blazing with light thou didst reach the sun, the luminous realm of heaven; the gods arranged themselves for thy friendship, O Indra.

sanskrit: endra no gadhi priyaḥ satrājid agohyaḥ | girir na viśvatas pṛthuḥ patir divaḥ ||
english: Come to us, O Indra, thou who art dear, the all-conqueror, unconcealed; like a mountain broad on all sides, lord of the sky.

sanskrit: abhi hi satya somapā ubhe babhūtha rodasī | indrāsi sunvato vṛdhaḥ patir divaḥ ||
english: For, O true soma-drinker, thou hast become the guardian of both worlds, heaven and earth; thou art the increaser of the soma-presser, lord of the sky.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hi śaśvatīnām indra dartā purām asi | hantā dasyor manor vṛdhaḥ patir divaḥ ||
english: For thou art the breaker of eternal fortresses, O Indra; slayer of the Dāsa, increaser of Manu, lord of the sky.

sanskrit: adhā hīndra girvaṇa upa tvā kāmān mahaḥ sasṛjmahe | udeva yanta udabhiḥ ||
english: Now indeed, O Indra, lover of praises, we release our great desires toward thee, as waters that rise upward.

sanskrit: vār ṇa tvā yavyābhir vardhanti śūra brahmāṇi | vāvṛdhvāṁsaṁ cid adrivo dive-dive ||
english: Like water do the sacred verses magnify thee, O hero, with their streams — thee who hast grown great, O lord of the stone-bolt, day by day.

sanskrit: yuñjanti harī iṣirasya gāthayorau rathe uruyuge | indravāhā vacoyujā ||
english: They yoke the two bay steeds of the swift one in the spacious chariot with wide yoke — the two Indra-bearing, speech-yoked ones.

sanskrit: tvaṁ na indrā bharaṁ ojo nṛmṇaṁ śatakrato vicarṣaṇe | ā vīram pṛtanāṣaham ||
english: Bring us, O Indra, fullness of might, manly vigour, O Śatakratu, wide-seeing; bring us a hero who withstands armies.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hi naḥ pitā vaso tvam mātā śatakrato babhūvitha | adhā te sumnam īmahe ||
english: For thou hast become our father, O Vasu, thou hast become our mother, O Śatakratu; therefore we implore thy favour.

sanskrit: tvāṁ śuṣmin puruhūta vājayantam upa bruve śatakrato | sa no rāsva suvīryam ||
english: O strong one, O widely invoked, I call upon thee, the prize-winner, O Śatakratu; do thou grant us good heroic strength.

sanskrit: tvām idā hyo naro apīpyan vajrin bhūrṇayaḥ | sa indra stomavāhasām iha śrudhy upa svasaram ā gahi ||
english: Thee indeed yesterday the eager men refreshed, O wielder of the bolt; so, O Indra, bearer of praises, hear here — come for the early-morning rite.

sanskrit: matsvā suśipra harivas tad īmahe tve ā bhūṣanti vedhasaḥ | tava śravāṁsy upamāny ukthyā suteṣv indra girvaṇaḥ ||
english: Be exhilarated, O fair-jawed one with the bay steeds; this we crave; the wise ones adorn thee; thy fames are supreme, worthy of lauds, at the soma-pressings, O Indra, lover of praises.

sanskrit: śrāyanta iva sūryaṁ viśved indrasya bhakṣata | vasūni jāte janmāna ojasā prati bhāgaṁ na dīdhima ||
english: As they cling to the sun, eat from all of Indra's bounties; being born we have shone with vigour, at birth, steadfastly toward our share of good things.

sanskrit: anarśarātiṁ vasudām upa stuhi bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ | so asya kāmaṁ vidhato na roṣati mano dānāya codayan ||
english: Praise the giver of riches who never fails; auspicious are Indra's gifts; he does not neglect the wish of his worshipper, but urges his mind to giving.

sanskrit: tvam indra pratūrtiṣv abhi viśvā asi spṛdhaḥ | aśastihā janitā viśvatūr asi tvaṁ tūrya taruṣyataḥ ||
english: Thou, O Indra, art beyond all rivals in onslaughts; thou art the destroyer of curses, the producer, the pervader; thou art swift against the one who attacks.

sanskrit: anu te śuṣmaṁ turayantam īyatuḥ kṣoṇī śiśuṁ na mātarā | viśvās te spṛdhaḥ śnathayanta manyave vṛtraṁ yad indra tūrvasi ||
english: The two worlds followed after thy hastening might like two mothers after a child; all rivals are crushed by thy wrath when thou, O Indra, dost overwhelm Vṛtra.

sanskrit: ita ūtī vo ajaram praheatāram aprahitam | āśuṁ jetāraṁ hetāraṁ rathītamam atūrtaṁ tugryāvṛdham ||
english: From here, with his aid, invoke the unfailing, the unsent sender, the swift conqueror, the impeller, the foremost charioteer, the unassailable, the increaser of Tugrya's line.

sanskrit: iṣkartāram aniṣkṛtaṁ sahaskṛtaṁ śatamūtiṁ śatakratum | samānam indram avase havāmahe vasavānaṁ vasūjuvam ||
english: We invoke this same Indra for aid — the accomplisher of unaccomplished things, the force-created, the hundred-aided, the Śatakratu, the possessor of good things, swift as wealth.

sanskrit: ayaṁ ta emi tanvā purastād viśve devā abhi mā yanti paścāt | yadā mahyaṁ dīdharo bhāgam indrād in mayā kṛṇavo vīryāṇi ||
english: I come before thee with my whole body; all the gods approach me from behind; when thou shalt assign me my share, then with me, O Indra, perform heroic deeds.

sanskrit: dadhāmi te madhuno bhakṣam agre hitas te bhāgaḥ suto astu somaḥ | asaś ca tvaṁ dakṣiṇataḥ sakhā me adhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri ||
english: I offer thee a share of honey first; let the pressed soma be thy allotted portion; and thou shalt be my friend on the right side, and then let us smite many Vṛtras together.

sanskrit: pra su stomam bharata vājayanta indrāya satyaṁ yadi satyam asti | nendro astīti nema u tva āha ka īṁ dadarśa kam abhi ṣṭavāma ||
english: Bring forth your laud, eager for the prize, to Indra the true — if truth there be; 'Indra does not exist,' said a certain one; 'who has seen him? Whom shall we praise?'

sanskrit: ayam asmi jarataḥ paśya meha viśvā jātāny abhy asmi mahnā | ṛtasya mā pradiśo vardhayanty ādardiro bhuvanā dardarīmi ||
english: Here am I, O singer — look at me here; I surpass all beings with my greatness; the directions of Order cause me to grow; shattering, I shatter the worlds asunder.

sanskrit: ā yan mā venā aruhaṇ ṛtasya ekam āsīnaṁ haryatasya pṛṣṭhe | manaś cin me hṛda ā praty avocad acikradañ chiśumantaḥ sakhāyaḥ ||
english: When the Venas climbed up to meet me, me sitting alone on the back of the beloved one of Order — even my mind spoke back from the heart; the young friends cried out aloud.

sanskrit: viśvet tā te savaneṣu pravācyā yā cakartha maghavann indra sunvate | pārāvataṁ yat purusambhṛtaṁ vasv apāvṛṇoḥ śarabhāya ṛṣibandhave ||
english: All these things of thine are to be proclaimed at the soma-pressings, which thou, O Maghavan Indra, hast done for the soma-presser; the distant, abundantly-gathered wealth thou didst uncover for Śarabha, the kinsman of the seer.

sanskrit: pra nūnaṁ dhāvatā pṛthaṅ neha yo vo avāvarīt | ni ṣīṁ vṛtrasya marmaṇi vajram indro apīpatat ||
english: Run forward now separately — let not him who has held you back stop you here; Indra has struck the bolt into the vital part of Vṛtra.

sanskrit: manojavā ayamāna āyasīm atarat puram | divaṁ suparṇo gatvāya somaṁ vajriṇa ābharat ||
english: Swift as thought, advancing, he crossed the iron fortress; the fair-winged bird flew to heaven and brought the soma to the wielder of the bolt.

sanskrit: samudre antaḥ śayata udnā vajro abhīvṛtaḥ | bharanty asmai saṁyataḥ puraḥprasravaṇā balim ||
english: The bolt lies within the ocean, surrounded by water; the assembled ones, whose streams flow forward, bring tribute to him.

sanskrit: yad vāg vadanty avicetanāni rāṣṭrī devānāṁ niṣasāda mandrā | catasra ūrjaṁ duduhe payāṁsi kva svid asyāḥ paramaṁ jagāma ||
english: When Vāc speaks things that lack understanding — she who is the queen of the gods has sat down pleasing; she has milked four strengthening milkings; where then has her highest form gone?

sanskrit: devīṁ vācam ajanayanta devās tāṁ viśvarūpāḥ paśavo vadanti | sā no mandreṣam ūrjaṁ duhānā dhenur vāg asmān upa suṣṭutaitu ||
english: The gods brought forth the divine Vāc; all living beings speak her in manifold forms; may she, the cow Vāc, that milch-cow milking joy and strength, come to us with her excellent praise.

sanskrit: sakhe viṣṇo vitaraṁ vi kramasva dyaur dehi lokaṁ vajrāya viṣkabhe | hanāva vṛtraṁ riṇacāva sindhūn indrasya yantu prasave visṛṣṭāḥ ||
english: O friend Viṣṇu, stride out more widely; O heaven, give space for the bolt to prop itself; let us smite Vṛtra, let us release the rivers — let them flow forth at Indra's urging.
